scope: Owned restricted guest control only;no product capture/method admission/full rebuild/physical media/shared-desktop read
authority: Existing local cross-unit implementation/testing grant and guest setup grant;this creates no owner acceptance or general authority.
design: Compile a private Windows UI capture primitive and separately compiled challenge renderer. The owning UI thread creates the memory DC/DIB and sends WM_PRINTCLIENT to its own window. No GDI handle crosses process boundaries;no DLL injection or hook/desktop-DC fallback.

pixel_recipe.comparison: All23040 RGB pixels equal the independently computed fixed recipe per phase;ignore only unused alpha. Same HWND/PID/desktop/nonce in both phases;require different payloads.

requirements: Run the current32MiB original capacity/confinement/canary/interruption proof and all8 raw-I/O controls before the capture experiment. Keep old invalidated/closed routes disabled.

Keep the challenge out of the capture primitive interface. Fix expected full RGB buffers before launching the renderer. Capture is an explicit owned repaint,not proof of an on-screen compositor image.

Check actual process/UI thread,job membership,private station/desktop,window nonce,held-image file ID and geometry before rendering. Revalidate identity and geometry afterwards;no pixels escape a changed epoch or bounds.

Create only fresh anonymous owned test jobs. Give the disposable actor JOB_OBJECT_QUERY only via two explicit non-inheritable DuplicateHandle transfers to the suspended, already assigned child. Bind the numeric handles in its bounded stdin before resuming;no job-name lookup. Query the same256MiB/eight-process limits before assignment. Close all owned handles after verified retirement.

Every queryable membership job has a separate unnamed supervisor job,assigned before resuming the child,whose handle is not inherited or exposed to it. Prove closing the supervisor handle alone kills a hung child that still holds its membership-job query handle;explicit job retirement remains required. This is a controller-handle-loss control,not an actual VM shutdown.

Hold the actual executable object read-only against writes/deletion. Verify its bytes/file ID before/after;observe refused write/delete opens. No ACL changes to product records/shared binaries or guest/host policy.

Require exact A/B observed pixels plus rejection of stale-A-as-B and zero surface. An intentionally blank renderer may return capture status but must fail the independent pixel oracle. A hung renderer must be retired by its3-second job deadline;no capture success follows from it.
Check GDI object counts before/after successful captures;retain distinct per-phase source/producer/frame/pixel identities and show actual retained PNGs for visual review.

Retain only known challenge pixels or uniform-zero diagnostics;unknown pixels are hashes/metadata only. Verify compact raw archive,owned account/image/source/process cleanup and host reserve before claiming this control pass.

A passing control does not qualify the product,its six required PNG cases,other platforms,owner acceptance or main promotion. Review the later private product invocation/transport separately before production-image use.
